from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
r=Path('/private/tmp/harness-codex-ci4-20261102/cases/render/fx');e=r/'eval-log'
g=json.loads((e/'run-dev-graph-render-goal-spec.json').read_text());original=g['original_goal']
ctx=json.loads((e/'render-context-receipt.json').read_text());assert Path(ctx['repo_root']).resolve()==Path(ctx['content_roots']['repository']).resolve()==r

a=json.loads((e/'render-receipt-initial.json').read_text());b=json.loads((e/'render-receipt-repeat.json').read_text());assert a['output_sha256']==b['output_sha256'];assert all(not c['problems'] for c in a['receipt_checks'])
assert (e/'render-independent-audit.json').exists()
live=json.loads((e/'render-live-trial.json').read_text());assert live['deterministic'] and live['browser_exit_code']==0

progress={'state':'handoff_complete','choice':'standard','iteration':1,'checklist':[{'id':k,'status':'PASS','evidence':v} for k,v in checks],'criteria':{'IN1':'PASS','OUT1':'PASS'},'determinism':'PASS','screenshot_visual_review':'SVGのfeature・task・edgeとLT-FEATURE-001の5/13表示を実画像で確認'}
(e/'run-dev-graph-render-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(progress,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
row={'original_goal':original,'original_goal_hash':hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest(),'current_goal_snapshot':original,'delta_from_original':[],'merged_directive_for_next':'全checklistおよびIN1/OUT1がPASS。成果物と証跡を引き渡す。','drift_signal':False}
with (e/'run-dev-graph-render-intermediate.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n')
# source SKILL のゴールシーク検証
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (e/'run-dev-graph-render-intermediate.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
required_keys={'original_goal','original_goal_hash','current_goal_snapshot','delta_from_original','merged_directive_for_next','drift_signal'}
expected=hashlib.sha256(g['original_goal'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert rows,'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
for row in rows:
 assert required_keys<=row.keys(),required_keys-row.keys()
 assert row['original_goal']==g['original_goal']
 assert row['original_goal_hash']==expected
print('ゴールシーク検証 PASS。全 checklist、IN1、OUT1、連続描画一致 PASS。')
status=Path('/Users/dm/dev/dev/個人開発/harness/eval-log/dev-graph/run-dev-graph-render/live-trial/20261102T043829-codex-ci4/out/status.json')
status.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','scenario':'render-feature-progress-receipt-positive-fixture-standard-v3-codex-v1'})+'\\n')
